text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tahaha, I ate way too much of the snacks~ 
I felt bad leaving any behind, so I even 
went for seconds.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Alright, no snacking today and— ...A 
notification? It's from Mira-ko-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"Waaah, I bought way too much cake~! I'm 
leaving it in the dorm fridge, please help 
me eat it!" Whoa, this is the kind you 
have to wait in a huge line to buy...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, the calories, though... but she lined 
up so long just to get this for me... 
...Maybe it'll be fine if I work out extra 
hard?
